Продажи: только идентифицированные клиен: Sales include identified customers at the six boutiques, filtered by order creation date, with item status done. Sales use OrderLinePriceOfLine without multiplying by quantity again. Returns and other statuses are excluded. This reflects the current state of original orders, not returns processed during the period. Orders and customers are counted distinctly; staff counts must not be summed.
Регистрации: первое доступное событие ка: Registrations use each customer’s earliest available event across the uploaded file, then filter by period. No purchase on registration day means no offline order with a done item at any of the six boutiques on the same Moscow calendar date. A purchase earlier that day also excludes the customer. Purchases on other days have no effect. Share = customers with no same-day purchase / all customers registered during the period. Staff uses the current ConsultantWhoRegistered field. Unknown boutiques remain a separate group and are not inferred from purchases. Complete registration history is needed to exclude repeat events accurately.
Детализация продавцов предусмотрена с 9: Salesperson attribution is available from 9 October 2026. Registering staff may change over time. Reports exclude anonymous sales. Profile completeness is measured at export time.
